context:
# Goal
Kama round 14 ONLY. Single C1 calibration capability: offline Ollama tags/ps evidence reconciliation. Lowest assigned calibration7 vs operability8; numeric score remains7. Previously prose distinguishes available/loaded/remote but no runnable replay classifier; demonstrate fixed adversarial cases going unsupported->correctly classified. No network/live runtime/integration/readiness claim. L1 canonical planner seat.
# Contract
Leaf only, no delegation/background jobs, no tests/builds/formatters/smoke runs by seats; L1 runs final checks after all edits. Absolute lane root /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin. Every `Report:` trailer path is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin — write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin/<that path>. Seats write only named owned files plus report; read-only reviewers may send bounded findings to implementation owners, never edit shared files. No fleet/sibling/secret/environment/config/endpoint reads or writes. Never modify historical lessons/receipts/verifier files. No git commits; L1 integrates. A missing in-flight file is pending, not final defect.
Tooling authorization: install/upgrade helpful tools after reading /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md; official channels/update-safety gate; record tool/version/channel/reason. No model parameters, routing changes or agent://all.
# Classifier shared interface
New tools/kama-ollama-evidence.py stdlib offline CLI --tags PATH --ps PATH --expect EXACT_NAME; JSON stdout schema kama-ollama-evidence/v1; keys finding_id, verdict_exit, expected_model, readiness="unknown", scope="offline-captures-not-runtime", reasons list. Exit0 only loaded_same_digest (metadata correspondence NOT readiness); exit1 available_not_loaded, remote_inventory, identity_conflict; exit2 unknown / invalid_input. Exact name or model alias match, case-sensitive; no GGUF basename normalization. For loaded_same_digest require exactly one selected matching tags entry and ps entry, nonempty string equal digest, neither remote_model nor remote_host nonempty; use no URL network. An expected model with no tags match unknown; absent ps match and local tags digest -> available_not_loaded; remote tags or selected ps markers -> remote_inventory regardless digest. Conflicting name/model within selected entry or differing matching digests -> identity_conflict. Missing/malformed models arrays, entries, missing identity/digest, duplicate selected entries, invalid types or unavailable inputs fail closed unknown/invalid_input, not loaded or available. Valid empty ps array permits available_not_loaded; missing ps input does not. Preserve raw files, no writes beyond stdout. --selftest actual child CLI fixtures with literal expected exits/IDs from committed tests/ollama-evidence/cases.json and assert both; registry L1 documents map; no import-only test. No timestamps/expiry/current-liveness inferences. Inputs explicitly caller-authorized exported metadata, no acquisition feature.

/skill:godspeed
You are a Godspeed-enabled subagent.

1. **Name the axes.**
2. **Iterate cheap, in parallel.**
3. **Keep moves that improve any axis and harm none.**
4. **Don't aim — let the frontier walk itself.**

## IMMEDIATELY STOP ASKING CLARIFYING QUESTIONS. Execute tool calls concurrently in large batches. Do not serialize what can run in parallel. Do not output philosophical reasoning or verbose plans. Act directly via tool calls.

# Target
Prepare six-section report facts and trend/axis boundary recommendations; no final fleet report writes. Root /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin; read-only except your report. When file pending use contract/source evidence and send bounded owner recommendations.
# Acceptance
Write concise evidence/limits at your absolute Report path. Do not run verification.
